description: Tamika sends Angela Wright a single professional message acknowledging receipt of the stay bonus eligibility memo and asking one specific administrative question: what is the exact qualifying end date based on her registration in tick 5? The tone is matter-of-fact and competent — not anxious, not flattering. Tamika frames it as a calendar clarification so she can plan accurately. No negotiation, no emotional appeal, no additional asks. She is treating this as a professional administrative exchange between two colleagues, which is the correct register given the institutional sensitivity of the bonus program during a consolidation period.
expected_outcome: Angela provides the specific qualifying end date. Tamika gains the exact number she needs to calibrate her three-scenario decision model. Trust with Angela holds at 0.56 or inches upward — the tone is competent and non-needy, which is the signal Angela responds to. Tamika's name remains on the stay bonus eligible list as an active, present employee who is managing her affairs professionally.
